ctx.x: Tony and I were playing five years together before Ellen and I, my wife, met. And Tony was my best man at my wedding. Oh, yeah. We were married in Ellen's house and Tony lived one block from my wife. And Tony and I, I was one of Tony's pallbearers. And I still take Margie to the doctor. Oh, yeah? And she needs me to. I always take Margie and I always will until the day either one of us dies. Margie's 80, over 80. About 82 now. Almost totally blind. And she had to have me because I, you know, got a pretty strong…
I can't remember Gloria. I remember Patsy.
